title: Copy parts never write a slot twice, plan limits above the kit are clamped, and undecided demo videos are hidden
steps: S1: In the TCH checkout with dependencies installed, run run.cmd (no database needed).
S2: Confirm every test named in run.tests reports ok.
expect: Merged parallel copy parts keep the first part's entry of a slot or alt both parts wrote; writing turns merge unchanged.
A plan maxCharacters above the kit limit gets the kit limit; one within it is kept.
A business.video slot a kept block or kept row shows and the plan left undecided is hidden; everything else stays with the planner.

tests: a slot or alt two parts both wrote keeps the first part entry, and everything else stays in writing order
a number above the kit limit gets the kit limit, the one the writer reads; a number within it is kept
an undecided video of a shown row, and one of the block itself, are hidden; rows the list does not show are not
